user.title: Yeelight Night Mode
user.description: This creates an entity for every Yeelight light that supports moonlight/night mode. Choose which kind of entity to create - you can change this later in the integration's Options. The selected Entity ID naming setting determines the entity ID (object ID) of each new entity. The Entity name setting controls the visible name; choose Custom to enter your own name. For the ID sources, the part after the dot is used. Custom IDs support <binary_sensor_id> and <light_entity_id> placeholders.

abort.already_configured: Already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

error.custom_entity_name_required: Enter a custom entity ID when Custom is selected.

init.title: Yeelight Night Mode
init.description: Choose whether the night-mode entity for each bulb should be a switch or a light. Changing this reloads the integration and recreates the entities. The selected Entity ID naming setting determines the entity ID (object ID) of each new entity. The Entity name setting controls the visible name; choose Custom to enter your own name. For the ID sources, the part after the dot is used. Custom IDs support <binary_sensor_id> and <light_entity_id> placeholders.
